data.long_meaning: Japanese name derived from the word hana, meaning flower. In Christian context, Hanae can symbolize the blooming of faith or the beauty of spiritual growth. The name Hanae carries the meaning “Flower” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hanae usually hope their child will grow to embody flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hanae total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
data.cultural_impact: The name Hanae is considered an elegant and beautiful name in Japanese culture, which can also be reflective of one's refined taste and appreciation for nature.
data.spiritual_significance: In a Christian context, Hanae can symbolize the blooming of faith or the beauty of spiritual growth, as the name derives from the Japanese word for flower. It highlights the idea that just as a flower blooms and brings joy, so too can one's faith and spirituality bring joy and growth into one's life.

biblical_reference.note: The name Hanae (חנה) is borne by the wife of Elkanah, the father of the prophet Samuel.
